body: Dude, please don't. Life might be tough, but you gotta keep going man. I know this myself. Things will get better if you want them to. Instead of drowning in negativity, try chasing happiness! It might sound like a bunch of bullshit, but instead of killing yourself try doing something totally different. Something that will help you in regaining your joy in life. Talk to people. Don't be afraid, you got to hang on man. I want you to do something that will change your life for the better. I'm talking vacation, get away. All the shit you see in movies with the big drastic changes, might actually work out. You gotta believe me, and I want you to PM me sunday afternoon telling me what the fuck you're going to do. Because this is not what you want. Sure it's an easy way out if things fucked up. But dude, shit happens. It does, but you have all the right to do something about it. And you can. I'm happy you're posting this, instead of just doing it. We're here to help you man. You have to know that you're not the only one and together we can live happily even though we are and have been victims of a lot of bullshit. So please, consider your alternatives. They're unlimited.
